topics: Current events of national and international importance.
History of Modern India with special reference to Maharashtra and Indian National Movement.
Geography of India with physical, social and economic geography of Maharashtra.
Maharashtra State Board syllabus on Indian Polity and Governance - Constitution of India, Political System, Panchayati Raj, Urban Administration, Public Policy, Rights Issues, etc.
Economic and Social Development - Sustainable Development, Poverty, Inclusion, Demographics, Social Sector initiatives, etc.
General issues on Environmental Ecology, Bio-diversity and Climate Change.
General Science - Physics, Chemistry, Zoology, Botany, Hygiene.
